questions: Which retained rows and environment terms actually cause the post-deletion residue?
Does the same reconstruction recipe still fail when the same world's revealed road has been observed?
correction: M1/M2 are concrete imperfect selection/repair attempts, not accurate-ownership or ideal-repair controls. 99.9% is original-view pre-deletion contribution coverage, not identity recall.

source_control.selection: reuse original recall_verified, no new ownership claim
source_control.roi: independent original-body firsthit AND independent delete-road firsthit
source_control.records: each retained static row before/after actual alphaT, view color, geometry, error attribution, original 16-view replay and sparse measurement support
source_control.causal_tests: fixed top32/128/512 removals; fixed-alpha privileged color sensitivity; environment replacements separately
source_control.reference_used: independent edit RGB only in explicitly privileged evaluation/source diagnosis; no classifier or reconstruction fitting

evidence_control.world: same procedural vehicle, road, lights, materials and object trajectory
evidence_control.sensor_bundle: 16 times, same K/resolution, original cameras 0/8/15; other13 hybrid8_z3.5
evidence_control.selection_reason: exact world-ray firsthit precheck: old-anchor revealed road all at least once visible; 98.954% in 2+ views
evidence_control.fixed: baseline world-to-model gauge, camera extent, native recipe, seed, 30K LR horizon and formal 10K updates
evidence_control.changed: legal RGB/LiDAR observations and resulting initialization; not a pure RGB-only or identical-capacity intervention
evidence_control.input_isolation: no dense GT geometry/material or delete/edited RGB passed to native training; oracle masks/tracks inherited disclosed sensor controls
evidence_control.smoke: real native600s loop, checkpoint/eval/full restore/next delete stage; updates and retries separate
evidence_control.formal: fresh10000 updates, no warm start from smoke
evidence_control.evaluation: same original0/8/15 and heldout query cameras, native dynamic-delete/shift/rotate; stratify original observed vs never-seen road
evidence_control.no_guarantee: world geometric visibility does not guarantee unshadowed radiance, finite-pixel evidence or identifiable Gaussian ownership

scope: one mechanism scene, no transferable module trained, no full shadow GT, no bulk data generation
